title: SPI-Math Standard Alignment Record
description: A single external-standard alignment record in the SEPARATE, SPI-keyed alignment store (curriculum/alignments/*). The relation is ALWAYS alignment -> SPI: the record carries the SPI objective IDs it links TO via linkedSpiObjectiveIds; the SPI objectiveId is the stable single source of truth. This schema is ADDITIVE and does NOT touch curriculum-objective.schema.json or its 30 frozen inline externalAlignments records. See SPI_MATH_OBJECTIVE_REGISTRY_AND_STANDARDS_PROPOSAL.md S9.

standardSet.description: The external framework/syllabus family token (open controlled vocabulary, e.g. 'IGCSE-0580', 'SG-LOWER-SEC', 'IB-DP-AA-SL').

standardVersion.description: Edition/year of the framework (a code is meaningless without its edition, e.g. '2025').

standardId.description: The external code as printed by the framework (opaque; never parsed for meaning, e.g. '0580/C1.11').

statement.description: Verbatim external statement wording. Reference only; never implies reuse rights.

framework.description: RETAINED legacy key mirroring standardSet, for future inline-read-cache compatibility (S9.4). Optional.

code.description: RETAINED legacy key mirroring standardId, for future inline-read-cache compatibility (S9.4). Optional.

linkedSpiObjectiveIds.description: THE ANCHOR. The SPI objective IDs this external standard links TO. One external standard may map to several SPI objectives. Every entry must resolve to a real, non-retired SPI objective (validated by G11).

alignmentType.description: How the external standard relates to the linked SPI objective(s).

status.description: Single confidence/status axis for this alignment record, independent of the objective's own reviewStatus.

notes.description: Free text for reasoning and scope caveats.

source.description: Provenance: who/what asserted the mapping and how.

version.description: Semantic version of THIS alignment record.
